displayName: Kiro Relay: Kiro CLI Models for Chat
description: Use the models from your Kiro subscription in VS Code Chat, authenticated through kiro-cli. Unofficial; not affiliated with AWS or Kiro.
command.diagnose.title: Diagnose Authentication
command.reloadCredentials.title: Reload Credentials
command.refreshModels.title: Refresh Models
command.manage.title: Manage
config.cli.path.description: Path to the kiro-cli executable (used for token renewal, sign-in and diagnostics).
config.auth.sources.description: Credential sources, in priority order. 'kiro-cli-db' = kiro-cli's SQLite database; 'sso-cache' = ~/.aws/sso/cache/kiro-auth-token.json.
config.auth.databasePath.description: Path to kiro-cli's data.sqlite3. Empty = detect automatically.
config.auth.ssoCachePath.description: Directory of the SSO cache. Empty = ~/.aws/sso/cache.
config.auth.refreshLeewaySeconds.descrip: Margin before expiry at which the token is no longer treated as valid.
config.reasoningEffort.markdownDescripti: Thinking effort per model, for example `{ "claude-opus-5": "xhigh" }`. A choice in the Chat model picker takes precedence. Levels the model does not accept are ignored.
config.auth.renewCommand.description: kiro-cli arguments the extension runs to have kiro-cli renew an expired token (default: whoami). Empty list = never run kiro-cli; you renew it yourself by using kiro-cli.
command.signIn.title: Sign In with kiro-cli
command.refreshUsage.title: Refresh Credit Usage
config.login.license.description: Account type used by **Kiro Relay: Sign In with kiro-cli** (`kiro-cli login --license`).
config.login.startUrl.description: IAM Identity Center start URL, e.g. `https://example.awsapps.com/start` (`kiro-cli login --identity-provider`). Empty = kiro-cli asks.
config.login.region.description: IAM Identity Center region, e.g. `us-east-1` (`kiro-cli login --region`). Empty = kiro-cli asks.
config.login.deviceFlow.description: Use the device code flow (`--use-device-flow`): sign in from a browser on any machine with a code.
config.login.deviceFlow.auto: Only in remote windows (Dev Containers, SSH, WSL), where there is no browser next to kiro-cli.
config.auth.sessionHours.description: Duration of your IAM Identity Center session in hours (8 is the AWS default; your organization may use another value). Only used to estimate when you will need to run `kiro-cli login` again.
